notes.title: Update 9.4 has released! Force Feedback for some devices has been added
notes.content:
Several things were improved due to player feedback
Added Experimental Force Feedback for Logitech Trusthmaster and some Fanatec Models
The jump in the race track is now easier to complete
Other players now have map icons to be easy to find
Cars have an angle readout to know how steep the hill you are climbing is
Added new challenging hill climb near spawn

notes.title: Alpha 7 is out - $50 Prize Event this week
notes.content:
Alpha 7 is out and we will have an event for a $50 prize this week. Friday October 18th at 8:00 EST. Join the Discord for more details.
Changes of Alpha 6 and 7

Added world borders to keep cars from falling out
Added Fuel simulation with Reserve Tanks and purchasing fuel
Added Volume settings
Improved Fuel Simulation values
Improved map with new roads and trails to find 
Fixed incorrect camera with ATV
Added Off-Road Track
